indicator.E_AI_BCDP: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of concerns regarding violation of data protection and privacy
indicator.E_AI_BCST: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because the costs seem too high
indicator.E_AI_BDDT: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of difficulties with availability or quality of the necessary data
indicator.E_AI_BINC: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of incompatibility with existing equipment, software or systems
indicator.E_AI_BLE: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of a lack of relevant expertise
indicator.E_AI_BLEG: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of a lack of clarity about the legal consequences
indicator.E_AI_BNU: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because artificial Intelligence technologies are not useful for Enterprise
indicator.E_AI_PBAM: Enterprises using AI technologies for organisation of business administration processes or management
indicator.E_AI_PFIN: Enterprises using AI technologies for accounting, controlling or finance management
indicator.E_AI_PITS: Enterprises using AI technologies for ICT security
indicator.E_AI_PLOG: Enterprises using AI technologies for logistics
indicator.E_AI_PMS: Enterprises using AI technologies for marketing or sales
indicator.E_AI_PPP: Enterprises using AI technologies for production processes
indicator.E_AI_PRDI: Enterprises using AI technologies for research and development (R&D) or innovation activity
indicator.E_AI_TANY: Enterprises using at least one of the AI technologies: AI_TTM, AI_TSR, AI_TNLG, AI_TIR, AI_TML, AI_TPA, AI_TAR, E_AI_TPVSG
indicator.E_AI_TAR: Enterprises using AI technologies enabling physical movement of machines via autonomous decisions based on observation of surroundings (autonomous robots, self-driving vehicles, autonomous drones)
indicator.E_AI_TIR: Enterprises using AI technologies identifying objects or persons based on images (image recognition, image processing)
indicator.E_AI_TML: Enterprises using machine learning (e.g. deep learning) for data analysis
indicator.E_AI_TNLG: Enterprises using AI technologies generating written or spoken language or programming codes (natural language generation, speech synthesis)
indicator.E_AI_TPA: Enterprises using AI technologies automating different workflows or assisting in decision making (AI based software robotic process automation)
indicator.E_AI_TPVSG: Enterprises using AI technologies generating pictures, videos, sound/audio
indicator.E_AI_TSR: Enterprises using AI technologies converting spoken language into machine-readable format (speech recognition)
indicator.E_AI_TTM: Enterprises using AI technologies performing analysis of written language (text mining)
indicator.E_AWSELL: Enterprises with web sales (via websites, apps or marketplaces)
indicator.E_AWS_CMP: Enterprises with web sales via e-commerce marketplaces
indicator.E_CC1_SI: Enterprises using sophisticated or intermediate paid CC services, at least one of: CC_PFACC, CC_PERP, CC_PCRM, CC_PSEC, CC_PDB, CC_PDEV
indicator.E_DA: Data analytics for the enterprise is performed by the enterprise's own employees or by an external provider
indicator.E_DASANY: Enterprises perform data analytics on data from any source
indicator.E_DI3_GELO: Enterprises with at least basic level of digital intensity (DII Version 3)
indicator.E_DI3_HI: Enterprises with high digital intensity index (DII version 3)
indicator.E_ITSP2: Enterprise employed ICT/IT specialists (reduced comparability with 2007)
indicator.E_ITSPRCR2: Enterprise recruited/tried to recruit personnel for jobs requiring ICT specialist skills (reduced comparability with 2007)
indicator.E_ITSPT2: Enterprise provided training to ICT/IT specialists to develop their ICT skills
indicator.E_ITSPVAC2: Enterprise had hard-to-fill vacancies for jobs requiring ICT specialist skills (reduced comparability with 2007)
indicator.E_ITT2: Enterprise provided training to their personnel to develop their ICT skills
indicator.E_SECAWANY: Enterprises make persons employed aware of their obligations in ICT security related issues
indicator.E_SECMDUO: ICT security measure used: combination of at least two authentication mechanisms (e.g. user-defined password, one-time password (OTP), code generated via a security token or received via a smartphone, biometric methods)
indicator.E_SECMGE1: Enterprises using any ICT security measure (as of 2022)
indicator.E_SECMGE3: Enterprises using at least 3 ICT security measures (as of 2022)
indicator.E_SECMGE5: Enterprises using at least 5 ICT security measures (as of 2022)
indicator.E_SECMOSBU: ICT security measure used: data backup to a separate location (including backup to the cloud)
indicator.E_SECMSPSW: ICT security measure used: strong password authentication
indicator.E_WEBORD: Enterprises where the website provided online ordering or reservation or booking, e.g. shopping cart
indicator.I_DSK2_AB: Individuals with above basic overall digital skills (all five component indicators are at above basic level)
indicator.I_DSK2_BAB: Individuals with basic or above basic overall digital skills (all five component indicators are at basic or above basic level)
indicator.I_IUAI: Use of generative AI tools: in the last 3 months
indicator.I_IUAIWP: Use of generative AI tools: for professional (work) purposes
